reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount from #shared/schedules, the same helper the forecast, schedules app and schedule templates use.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the range/number rule stays in the one helper (the extra `?? 0` merely repeats the helper's own null guard).

placement.why: The field is computed in scheduleModel.toExternal, the API model layer that maps schedules to their external shape.

scope.why: Two small additions: the type field and the mapping line.

maintainability.why: Minimal and clear; small nits are the redundant `?? 0`, the import placed after relative imports, and adding an output-only field to the type that also serves as the fromExternal input.
